source_title: Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch Remastered
continuity_scope: Bandai Namco Entertainment America English official-page witness for Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch Remastered, specifically its PlayStation 4 and PC remastered release description. The page's later Xbox/Windows announcement describes an enhanced release state and is not treated as mechanically or textually identical. The original title, regional/localized versions, Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom, other numbered/related games, the Cross Worlds mobile title, films, and other adaptations are separate works or continuity/product states.
work_or_witnesses: Bandai Namco Entertainment America, Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch Remastered official game page
coverage_rule: All named individual dramatic characters in the selected official page's supplied story synopsis: Oliver and Drippy. Oliver's mother is described but not named, so is not promoted to a character record. Familiars are an explicitly generic/tamable category; they, magic, locations, quests, enemies, the Wizard's Companion, combat, and all other systems remain terms/dimensions.
omissions: Oliver's unnamed mother, every unmentioned character, enemy, familiar, creature, kingdom, faction, location, and item; the official selected page gives no larger named character-profile set.
Player-chosen familiar taming, battle switching, tactics, quest completion, party choices, outcomes, endings, and any inferred magic/relationship details.

The original release, regional/localized versions, later Xbox/Windows enhanced state, Ni no Kuni II, Cross Worlds and all mobile/service content, DLC, other adaptations, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: The selected page contains a concise premise rather than full character dossiers. No biography beyond the supplied synopsis is supplied for Oliver or Drippy.

The page says the tale uses animation storyboarded and created by Studio Ghibli, and separately calls it a LEVEL-5 title; this is retained as a production-credit claim only, not generalized into authorship of every sequel, remaster feature, character, or franchise work.
The official page lists English and Japanese voice-overs but does not authorize a character-by-character dubbing, translation, or script-equivalence claim.
evidence_basis: Bandai Namco Entertainment America first-party English game page only. No fan or secondary source is used as canonical evidence.

citations.locator: Journey Back To The Other World; All-Star Production; Captivating Story; Dynamic Combat; platforms and Xbox announcement
supports: Remastered PS4/PC witness, later Xbox/Windows enhanced-state boundary, Oliver/Drippy premise, Wizard's Companion, familiars, Studio Ghibli storyboard/animation credit, Joe Hisaishi music credit, voice-over listing, and combat description
